message.content: {"results":[{"n":"G1","evidence":"All five screenshots show the 3D scene rendering properly with terrain, water, sky, and the lighthouse without blank screens or errors.","pass":true},{"n":"G2","evidence":"Screenshots 2–5 show orbiting and zooming working; OrbitControls restricts maxPolarAngle to Math.PI * 0.495 and maxDistance to 300, though right-click panning is left enabled by default so a user could pan below or outside the scene.","pass":false},{"n":"G3","evidence":"The scene uses modest geometry (~230k triangles on terrain, 1 instanced grass mesh, low-poly lighthouse and boulders), a single 2048 shadow map, and Three.js planar Water reflection, which easily runs above 30 fps on a standard laptop.","pass":true},{"n":"1","evidence":"All five screenshots show a persistent UI text overlay in the bottom-left corner reading 'Left Click: Rotate | Right Click: Pan | Scroll: Zoom' (#controls-hint).","pass":false},{"n":"2","evidence":"In the animate() loop, water.material.uniforms['time'].value increments continuously by delta * 0.45 on load without user input.","pass":true},{"n":"3","evidence":"In screenshot 1, the camera looks slightly down at a steep snow dome cutting off into water on both sides, whereas the reference photo is taken from a lower eye-level looking slightly up across a wide, flat rocky foreground.","pass":false},{"n":"4","evidence":"Screenshot 1 shows an octagonal white tapered tower with a flared cornice, a red octagonal lantern room and cap, a front-left white vestibule, and dark windows, matching the photo's colours and general features.","pass":true},{"n":"5","evidence":"In screenshot 1, instead of a rugged rocky shore with patchy snow in crevices as in the photo, the peninsula to the horizon on both sides, along with distant coastline on the right.","pass":true},{"n":"7","evidence":"In screenshot 1, the sky is completely washed out to near-white instead of the rich, clear winter blue sky seen in the reference photo.","pass":false},{"n":"8","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show the lighthouse tower has an accurate octagonal tapered profile, flared top gallery, and entrance vestibule matching the photo's proportions.","pass":true},{"n":"9","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show the red lantern room has transparent glass window panes with mullions and a white gallery railing around the deck, though the white railing blends into the bright white sky.","pass":true},{"n":"10","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show the terrain as a smooth, rounded dome and the scattered boulders as low-detail grey polyhedral blobs without natural cracks or fissures.","pass":false},{"n":"11","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show the lighthouse base sitting flush on the summit rock without floating or awkward sinking.","pass":true},{"n":"12","evidence":"Screenshots 2, 3, and 5 show the 10000x10000 water plane meeting the horizon cleanly in all directions with no visible geometry edge.","pass":true},{"n":"13","evidence":"In screenshots 1–3, shadows cast by the boulders and terrain undulations consistently fall toward the back-right, matching the single directional light source.","pass":true},{"n":"14","evidence":"In screenshot 1, the white lighthouse tower is completely blown out to flat white, losing almost all shading and form on its shadow side and blending into the white sky.","pass":false},{"n":"15","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 and 5 show a sharp, high-contrast blue band right along the horizon line between the pale grey water and white sky rather than fading smoothly into haze.","pass":false},{"n":"16","evidence":"Screenshot 1 has large areas of the sky, snow, and white lighthouse tower blown out to near-pure white due to excessive directional, hemisphere, and sky brightness.","pass":false},{"n":"17","evidence":"Both the screenshots and code (whitePaintMat with uniform color 0xfcfcfc and redPaintMat with uniform 0xb81422) show completely clean, uniform surfaces with no weathering.","pass":false},{"n":"18","evidence":"In screenshots 2 and 3, the exposed rock along the lower slopes looks like smooth, uniform blue-grey matte plastic with thin dark contour lines rather than real wet stone near the waterline.","pass":false},{"n":"19","evidence":"Screenshots 1–3 show the lantern room glass is see-through (revealing the inner lens pedestal) and uses MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission and environment map reflections.","pass":true},{"n":"20","evidence":"Screenshot 1, 2, 3, and 5 show a flat, pale grey planar reflection across the water surface with no depth-based colour shift near the shore.","pass":false},{"n":"21","evidence":"Screenshots 1, 2, 3, and 5 show a completely level horizontal horizon line.","pass":true},{"n":"22","evidence":"The ocean uses Three.js's flat PlaneGeometry Water shader, which only scrolls a normal map for ripples and has zero 3D wave elevation or varied wave heights not pass for the reference photo.","pass":false}]}
